question: How long should a website audit take?
answer: Our automated AI audit completes in under 30 seconds — you enter your URL and get a full, categorised report instantly. A deeper manual audit from an agency (covering full-site crawls, competitor analysis and strategic recommendations) typically takes a few days to a couple of weeks depending on site size. Starting with our free instant audit is a good way to see exactly where the biggest issues are before deciding if deeper manual work is worth commissioning.
